backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows; accepted exp-20260520-004 trend-persistence broad-market adapter is the before state; after state adds a max-daily-return paper-notional support field on the frozen accepted candidate universe.

gate3.note: No new core filter was added; broad-market sleeve remains default-off paper only.

hypothesis: Already-selected broad-market leadership paper candidates whose 20-day path is not spike-dominated may convert rank into more stable allocation quality than names dependent on one outsized day.
interpretation: Max daily return is a new production-visible path-quality field aligned with the playbook's daily-return-pattern direction. Promotion still requires identity control plus the same three-window gate used for other broad-market paper allocation fields, with the stricter >10% relative aggregate EV rule for this state-surface family.

llm_metrics.reason: This run avoids sparse LLM soft-ranking and does not alter LLM prompts or decisions.

next_evidence_needed: Collect more forward broad-market paper outcomes with max_daily_return_20 metadata; do not retry nearby thresholds on the frozen sample without new forward evidence or a distinct path-quality field.

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: capital allocation / path quality: already-selected broad-market leaders with less spike-dominated 20-day paths may deserve extra paper notional support.
protocol_answers.2_past_similar_experiments: Broad-market rank-notional, low-extension, high-volatility, trend-persistence, trend-efficiency, red-day pullback, strong-close crowding, and repeat-name support were tested; max_daily_return_20 path-quality support was not previously formalized.
protocol_answers.3_single_variable: Only max_daily_return_20_max/scalar changes inside one notional-support field; eligibility, rank profile, low-extension, high-volatility, trend-persistence, hold, slots, and frozen universe stay fixed.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance: Gate 4 requires positive aggregate EV/PnL, all 3 windows EV-positive, no EV/PnL regression windows, >=8 adjusted trades across all 3 windows, concentration guard, <=0.5pp max drawdown worsening, and >10% relative aggregate EV improvement.
protocol_answers.5_reproducibility: Script, frozen candidate universe, JSON artifact, log, ticket, markdown artifact, and JSONL identify windows, parameters, and metrics.

rejection_reason: Max-daily-return support did not clear the broad-market three-window gate, the stricter >10% relative aggregate EV rule, and/or identity control.
single_causal_variable: max daily return cap support scalar for fixed broad-market selected candidates

warehouse_audit.manifest_note: Partial warehouse is acceptable for this paper scout because the candidate set is restricted to all-window full-liquid rows.
